outcome: Conversion rate from neuraxial anesthesia to general anesthesia
cohort: 15,930 obstetric patients in a tertiary care center
finding: Neuraxial anesthesia constituted the vast majority of obstetric anesthesia, but there was a relatively high incidence of general anesthesia, which decreased during the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: The study found a decrease in the general anesthesia rate for cesarean section in 2020 compared to previous years.
